description: From fz-go4.18.8: the new test accessor product_transport_plan builds the FULL RootBackendProduct where the legacy drive_until_transport_plan stopped at the plan, so migrated heavy-fixture tests (enum_take_drop_split=00420, enum_predicate_search) now run >60s. They pass but the test-time regression matters for CI/matrix. Add a lighter accessor that drives only to the transport-shape product (not the full backend) for tests that only need the transport plan. Note: 00420 enum_take_drop_split is also the fz-f98.14 convergence-runaway fixture (>1s = convergence smell) — keep that separate.
title: Add a lighter product transport accessor (stop at the transport-shape product, not the full RootBackendProduct)
